summary.text: HCSA advertising rules apply to adverts accessible in Singapore. Overseas adverts must follow the laws there.

details.heading: Adverts accessible in Singapore
details.body: The advertising rules under HCSA apply when an advert can be accessed by people physically located in Singapore.

details.heading: Adverts in other jurisdictions
details.body: If a licensee advertises its services in other jurisdictions, it must follow the laws in those jurisdictions.

example_phrasings: Can a licensee appoint an overseas third-party administrator to advertise healthcare services abroad?
What rules apply to promoting medical tourism?
Can healthcare services be advertised in other countries?

sources.page_title: Can a licensee appoint a third-party administrator (based overseas) to advertise its licensable healthcare services in other jurisdictions, i.e. promoting medical tourism?

quotes.text: The rules on advertising under HCSA are aimed at protecting the safety and welfare of patients in Singapore, and hence apply to advertisements that are accessible by persons physically located in Singapore.
HCSA licensees that advertise their services in other jurisdictions will have to comply with the prevailing laws in that jurisdiction.
